title: 001 神异世界002 灶官办案
content_zh:
夏国，江城。
早晨七点半，“邦邦邦”
几声敲门响起。
“东子！
起床吃早餐了。”
“浔姐......”
许临东睁开眼，下床刚要穿裤子，“嘭”
地一声房门就被直接推开了。
“刚买的豆浆油条，趁热吃！”
一道身影径直走进来。
她一身浅灰针织开衫松松罩着纯色t恤，栗色及肩锁骨发一侧别在耳后，露出眼角那颗淡得几乎看不见的泪痣。
修长的双腿踩着慵懒的毛绒兔兔拖鞋，步伐却一点不拖沓，一进来就“唰”
地拉开了窗帘，动作利落得简直像治安官抓嫖。
“不是…浔姐！”
许临东一把抓起长裤挡在身下的短裤前，表情尴尬。
“下次等我穿好再进来行不行……”
“怎嘛？”
易千浔转过头，视线在他腿上停了停，轻哼一声。
“在家住多少年了，以前可没见你这么讲究。
当上了神异司的执行官，就跟姐生分了？”

许临东被噎得没话，只能摇头。
“没，就是吓一跳。”
“你不偷偷干坏事，姐会吓着你？”
易千浔狐疑瞅了眼房间垃圾桶，将手中早餐往桌上一放道，顺手从口袋里摸出一根棒棒糖叼在嘴角，“豆浆油条，趁热吃，别冷了。”
许临东严重怀疑这老司机连买早餐都在开车，但他没证据。
因为穿越来的这半年里，这个女人向来都是这样，只能说是本性如此了。
他也不敢多话，连连点头送这外表美丽的浔姐出去，赶紧穿上长裤，松了口气。
身为穿越者，这半年来他都没敢练手艺活儿，一直在维持原主人设，一个天赋尚可、努力上进、家庭和睦的年轻执行官形象。
毕竟在这超凡显世的世界，任何超出原主认知的反应，都可能引来怀疑。
偏偏这个浔姐又跟他简直是青梅竹马长大的，往往会过分亲近，让他这半年来简直是遭受穿越者最大的‘生死考验’。
好在半年过去，无论是他，还是这一家善待他的人，都已彻底适应、融洽相处。
“快趁热吃啊！
豆浆冷了可就不好喝了。”
外面易千浔的声音传来。
许临东回应了一声，简单洗漱了一下，坐到桌前拿起早餐开始吃。
他的目光扫过桌上自制的“灶烟”
等超凡物品，体内胃腑间的超凡力量随进食隐隐波动，思绪也随之起伏。
凭借前身的记忆与这半年来的快速恶补，他早已摸清了这个世界与周遭的一切。
这个世界的历史长河，与他曾经所处的世界在远古至封建时代，大致相同。
content_en:
Xia Kingdom, Jiangcheng.
At 7:30 in the morning, "bang bang bang"
There were several knocks on the door.
"Dongzi!
Got up and had breakfast. "
"Sister Xun..."
Xu Lindong opened his eyes and was about to put on his pants when he got out of bed, "Bang"
The door was pushed open directly with a bang.
"I just bought the soy milk fried dough sticks, eat them while they are hot!"
A figure walked straight in.
She was wearing a light gray knitted cardigan loosely covered with a solid color T-shirt. One side of her chestnut shoulder-length collarbone hair was tucked behind her ear, revealing an almost invisible tear mole in the corner of her eye.
Her slender legs were wearing lazy plush bunny slippers, but her steps were not sluggish at all. As soon as she walked in, she said, "Oh!"
He opened the curtains with a swift movement that looked like a police officer arresting a prostitute.
"No...Sister Xun!"
Xu Lindong grabbed his trousers and put them in front of his shorts, with an embarrassed expression.
"Can you wait until I'm dressed before coming in next time..."
"What?"
Yi Qianxun turned his head, his eyes stopped on his legs, and he hummed softly.
"How many years have I lived at home, and I have never seen you so particular before.
When you become the executive officer of the Department of Mysteries, you break up with your sister? "
Xu Lindong was choked and could only shake his head.
"No, I was just shocked."
"If you don't do bad things secretly, will my sister scare you?"
Yi Qianxun glanced at the trash can in the room suspiciously, put his breakfast on the table, took out a lollipop from his pocket and held it in the corner of his mouth, "Eat the soy milk and fried dough sticks while they're hot, don't let them get cold."
Xu Lindong seriously suspected that the old driver was driving even to buy breakfast, but he had no evidence.
Because in the six months since time travel, this woman has always been like this. It can only be said to be this way.
He didn't dare to say anything. He nodded repeatedly and sent the beautiful Sister Xun out. He quickly put on his trousers and breathed a sigh of relief.
As a time traveler, he has not dared to practice craft work in the past six months, and has been maintaining the image of the original owner, a young executive with fair talent, hard work, and a harmonious family.
After all, in this extraordinary world, any reaction beyond the original owner's knowledge may arouse suspicion.
However, this Sister Xun and he were almost childhood sweethearts when they were growing up, and they tended to get too close, which made him suffer the biggest 'life and death test' among time travellers in the past six months.
Fortunately, half a year has passed, and both he and the people in this family who treat him well have completely adapted to and get along well with each other.
“Eat it while it’s hot!
Soy milk doesn't taste good when it's cold. "
Yi Qianxun's voice came from outside.
Xu Lindong responded, washed briefly, sat at the table, picked up breakfast and started eating.
His eyes glanced at the homemade "stove smoke" on the table
Waiting for extraordinary items, the extraordinary power in the body's stomach and intestines fluctuates faintly as he eats, and his thoughts also fluctuate accordingly.
Relying on the memory of his predecessor and the rapid recovery in the past six months, he has already understood the world and everything around him.
The history of this world is roughly the same as the world he once lived in from ancient times to the feudal era.
